E7 (non-blocking): dispatch args/timestamp provenance - exact args and 11:29:18.383 come from close-out-finalized files (dispatch record 11:40:54, gate JSON 11:40:41) while their bound evidence is contemporaneous (frame/AX/detector/v8 mtimes 11:29:06-07) and the pre-dispatch intent (sha bead5155..., mtime 11:19:26) already named app.click([320,135]); the round's system-log observation independently corroborates event activity at 11:29:17.7-18.5.

Residual R1 (compiled native SkyComputerUseService; empirical pinning), R2 (12.4 s gate->dispatch interval), R3 (rendered-cursor anchor assumptions) are the round's disclosed residuals; my review confirms they are honestly disclosed rather than hidden and that none of them can flip the SAVE_ALL_HIT_CONFIRMED verdict (alternative mappings refuted by >=420 px; worst-case anchor shift leaves >=4.2 pt to the nearest band edge).

Weighed against the >=420 px falsification margins, the fixed-offset cross-calibration, and the disclosed residual R1, it does not overturn the verdict.
